title: Baseline learnability diagnostic
research_question: Can the H64 dense GRU learn delayed-evidence-v1 at 6000 updates, with delay controlled?
strongest_rejection_reason: Finite-set overfit does not establish generator learning.
hypothesis: Dense baseline achieves pre >=0.90 and joint >=0.50 in every diagnostic seed at delay8.
intervention: Training budget and delay diagnostics; no architectural comparison
resource_matching: Same model within each delay; token counts explicitly differ across delays
interpretation: Short-delay baseline feasible; delay8 remains near chance at 6000 updates.
limitations: exploratory diagnostic informed by EXP-0001 failure
next_action: Gate 1 stays closed; new task/optimization protocol required before any architecture efficacy comparison.
